messages.content: Could you tell me the current weather in Boston, MA and also in San Francisco? Please provide the temperatures in Fahrenheit.

message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to live weather feeds, so I can’t give you the exact temperature right now. If you’d like up‑to‑date numbers, here’s what you could do: | City | How to check | |------|--------------| | **Boston, MA** | • Visit a reliable weather site such as or use an app (Weather Underground, AccuWeather).
• Search “Boston” → look at the “Temperature” field on the main card.
• The value will already be shown in °F if your locale is set accordingly. | | **San Francisco, CA** | • Same steps—search “San Francisco” on any of those sites/applications.
• Check the “Temp.” box near the top of the page/card. | Alternatively, you can ask a voice assistant (“Hey Siri/Google/Bixby – What’s the temp in Boston?”) which usually returns the answer in degrees Fahrenheit automatically. Once you’ve got the figures, feel free to share them back here if you want help interpreting trends or comparing historical averages!
message.reasoning: The user wants current weather in Boston and SF with temps in F. I don't have real-time data; need to explain that can't fetch live info. Offer suggestion how to get it or approximate from known sources. Provide disclaimer.
